'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***Russian [[airstrike]]s in [[Kharkiv Oblast]] kill at least three people and injure four others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-people-killed-russian-air-attacks-ukraines-kharkiv-region-2024-04-10/ (Reuters)]
**[[Odesa strikes (2022–present)|Odesa strikes]]

**An [[Israel]]i attack in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] kills three civilians related to [[Ismail Haniyeh]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2024-04-10/ty-article-live/biden-slams-netanyahus-handling-of-gaza-campaign-war-cabinet-discusses-truce-talks/0000018e-c5c4-dfe9-a19f-f5e59fb70000 (''Haaretz'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2023–2024 video game industry layoffs]]
**American [[Video game industry|video game company]] [[Epic Games]] announces that it will lay-off around 870 employees, roughly one-sixth of its workforce, due to slower growth than expected. [https://ca.movies.yahoo.com/movies/fortnite-maker-epic-games-laying-155226279.html (CBC via Yahoo! News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A [[bus]] carrying [[Eid Al-Fitr]] pilgrims collides and [[bus plunge|plunge]]s into a ditch in [[Balochistan, Pakistan]], killing seventeen people and injuring 16 others. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-bus-crash-pilgrims-baluchistan-eid-alfitr-c7fba5e976be6a11a44a3fa0e2443d38 (AP)]
*Five people are killed and 35 others are injured in a fire at the [[New Lucky House]] in [[Kowloon]], [[Hong Kong]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/fire-hong-kongs-busy-kowloon-kills-five-2024-04-10/ (Reuters)]
*A person is killed by [[flood]]ing in [[Mississippi]], [[United States]], as [[severe weather]] hits the [[Southern United States]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/severe-weather-flooding-possible-tornadoes-texas-mississippi-louisiana-storms/ (CBS News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 South Korean legislative election]]
**South Koreans vote for members of the [[National Assembly (South Korea)|National Assembly]]. The opposition, primarily consisting of the [[Democratic Party (South Korea, 1955)|Democratic Party]], [[Democratic Alliance of Korea|its alliance]] and the [[Rebuilding Korea Party]], wins the election in a landslide, increasing their legislative majority but falling short of the two-thirds [[supermajority]] needed to pass constitutional amendments or override the veto of President [[Yoon Suk Yeol]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-opposition-wins-landslide-parliamentary-vote-resounding-blow-yoon-2024-04-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 United States presidential election]]
**[[Cornel West]] names [[Melina Abdullah]] as his VP pick as part of his [[Cornel West 2024 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2024/04/10/cornel-west-black-lives-matter-activist-melina-abdullah-vice-president-00151525/ (Politico)]
